chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, who said:

Abū al-Qāsim Mukhalad ibn Mūsā al-Rāzī wrote to ask him about the detached ʿumrah: is ṭawāf al-nisāʾ obligatory upon the one performing it? And about the ʿumrah by which one performs tamattuʿ up to hajj.

So he wrote: As for the detached ʿumrah, ṭawāf al-nisāʾ is obligatory upon the one performing it. But as for the one by which tamattuʿ is performed up to hajj, ṭawāf al-nisāʾ is not obligatory upon the one performing it.

key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ الْمَبْتُولَةِ: the detached or standalone ʿumrah performed independently of hajj
key_terms.صَاحِبِهَا: the person performing or undertaking that rite
key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: the circumambulation related to the permissibility of marital relations
key_terms.يُتَمَتَّعُ بِهَا إِلَى الْحَجِّ: the ʿumrah of tamattuʿ that is followed by hajj

ai.seo_question: Is ṭawāf al-nisāʾ obligatory in every type of ʿumrah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling distinguishing two types of ʿumrah. It states that ṭawāf al-nisāʾ is required in al-ʿumrah al-mabtūlah, but it is not required in the ʿumrah of tamattuʿ connected to hajj.
